wiki.title: Paul A. Lowe Jr.
wiki.extract: Paul A. Lowe Jr. (born May 19, 1959) is an American politician who has served in the North Carolina Senate from the 32nd district since 2015. He was first appointed to fill the vacancy left by Earline W. Parmon's resignation.
